Performance First

We build directly with WebGL, Canvas, and native binaries so every simulation opens fast and runs smoothly at 60 FPS, even on modest hardware.

Interactive Learning

Textbooks teach with static diagrams. We built interactive sandboxes so you can tweak gravity, test computer vision, and practice coding syntax live.

Free & Accessible

Education should never be gated behind paywalls or data brokers. Everything runs on your own machine, keeps your data private, and is completely free.

Core Principles

How We Build Software.
Fast, Native, and Private.

We don't use heavy wrappers or cloud dependencies where local code works best. Every tool runs directly on your machine with zero trackers, zero ads, and zero paywalls.

Runtime Design

Pure Native Runtimes

We compile directly to standalone binaries (C++ 64-bit, Python PyInstaller, Kotlin Android). No heavy Chromium shells eating 300 MB of RAM in the background.

0.0 MB
Third-Party Runtime Bloat
Native Architecture 100% Standalone
Private & Local

On-Device Processing

Your camera feed, audio, and keystrokes never leave your device. All computer vision and telemetry run through local WebAssembly and native threads.

100%
Local-First Execution
Privacy Isolation 100% • 0 Cloud Leaks
Performance

Sub-12ms Response

We write custom WebGL shaders and optimized render loops to eliminate input lag. Interactive simulations stay locked at a smooth 60 FPS on typical hardware.

< 12ms
Input-To-Display Latency
Frame Rate Lock Solid 60.0 FPS
